title: The Simultaneous Summit and Abyss

features.name: the-paradox-spine
features.desc-on-touch: The mountain and the chasm occupy the same coordinate. You are climbing and falling at once. Forgetting is the only verb that works in both directions.

features.name: descent-as-ascent
features.desc-on-touch: Every step downward is also a step up. The path branches into itself. You cannot tell whether you're climbing out or sinking in.

features.name: the-forgetting-ground
features.desc-on-touch: The only terrain that forgets equally in all directions. Step forward and you step backward. Climb and you descend. The ground has learned to contradict itself.

features.name: bidirectional-peak
features.desc-on-touch: A summit that is also a void. A peak that extends downward. Light and dark occupying the same height.

inscription: forgetting is the only verb that works in both directions at once; this is where it points both ways
